digest.component_or_area: CI test infrastructure and performance analysis
propositions: No individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeded 30 seconds in the three-run CI sample or exhaustive current-main macOS census; sampled CI maximum was 22.63s and local maxima were 15.62s default and 21.96s integration.

Gerrit 1817 removed exactly 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, yielding approximately 8 seconds macOS critical-path savings and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds without creating new jobs or setup overhead.

External analyzer grounding, plan/completion/identity/signing lifecycle, Git store/locks/concurrency, and import/packaging families remain contractual real-boundary work that cannot be removed or mocked without reducing fidelity; partial-clone, show-under-write-burst, and pandoc probes contain optional future research opportunities but require equivalence proof before consolidation.

Repository text/AST duplication was a defect fixed by 1817; all remaining candidate families for macOS-to-Ubuntu routing contain filesystem/Git/socket/subprocess/tool-discovery/platform behavior that preserves macOS assurance, and new shard/job creation remains rejected because prior experiment increased job-minutes 18.6→21.0 and burst contention 22.3→25.2.

The 501-unique-phase inventory (>=1s union of local exhaustive macOS census and CI top-25 observations) shows all phases belong to one of seven disposition families: keep current coverage (external analyzers, plan/completion/identity/signing, Git store/locks, import/packaging, editor E2E, signing contracts); keep-equivalence-only pending fault-seeded proof (show-under-write-burst, two-clone/process, partial-clone); keep-research pending equivalence or corpus work (analyzer grounding, pandoc bounded-live, partial-clone guard); or keep-shorten-test-windows for deploy/reviewbot/observability scripts which preserve production budgets while scaling test-only triggers.

Ranked next actions without code/workflow/CI changes: approved implementation songful-groovelike-horsemouse (test-only clocks/windows); research/equivalence lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, rival-ammoniacal-crustacean; retain and monitor N=3000 import, real scanner boundaries, two-clone/concurrency, platform suites; await organic descendant of 1817 before attributing measured delta; do not create new macOS/Ubuntu shard or increase aggregate runner use.
